description: This file defines a class `ProtocolMessageExtractor` responsible for parsing WebSocket protocol messages into control message objects such as `Jwt`, `StartStreaming`, and `StopStreaming`. It extracts message types, parameters, and creates corresponding objects, mainly for managing streaming control over a WebSocket connection in a gateway service.

classes.name: ProtocolMessageExtractor
classes.description: A class implementing a function to parse WebSocket protocol messages into control message objects, handling message type identification, parameter parsing, and object creation.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Main method that takes a protocol message string and returns an Optional of StreamControlMessage after parsing the message.

methods.name: getProtocolMessageType
methods.description: Determines the type of protocol message based on the message prefix.

methods.name: getJwt
methods.description: Extracts JWT token from message parameters and creates a Jwt object.

methods.name: determineParams
methods.description: Parses parameter string from protocol message into a map of key-value pairs.

methods.name: getStartStreaming
methods.description: Creates a StartStreaming object based on message parameters and message type.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Parses namespaces parameter into a list of namespace strings.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldSelector based on extra fields parameter.

methods.name: getStopStreaming
methods.description: Creates a StopStreaming object for the given message type.
